title: micromeria canariensis subsp. meridialis
intro: Micromeria canariensis subsp. meridialis, commonly known as Canary Islands thyme, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Canary Islands. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria canariensis subsp. meridialis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
